details.label: Limitations and gaps
Task-specific test record

metrics.chance: set by permuting hidden labels over the same clusters (the verdict's null)
metrics.definition: For each label, F1 of its hidden genes against the ONE cluster chosen for it on visible genes; averaged with labels weighted by their hidden genes. A label with no cluster scores 0.
metrics.label: Weighted F1
metrics.reading: Whether a label that nobody showed the clustering falls out as a cluster, scored on genes the choice never saw.

metrics.definition: For each label, the share of hidden genes in its chosen cluster that carry it; label-size weighted.
metrics.label: Weighted precision
metrics.reading: How pure the chosen clusters are.

metrics.chance: about the cluster's share of the genes
metrics.definition: For each label, the share of its hidden genes that landed in its chosen cluster; label-size weighted.
metrics.label: Weighted recall
metrics.reading: How completely each label is gathered into one cluster.

metrics.definition: Agreement between the clustering and the hidden labels over all pairs of hidden genes, corrected so random partitions of the same sizes score 0.
metrics.label: Adjusted Rand index (ARI)
metrics.reading: Whole-partition agreement, independent of which cluster was chosen for which label.

metrics.chance: small but above 0 for many small clusters
metrics.definition: Mutual information between clusters and hidden labels, divided by the mean of their entropies.
metrics.label: Normalised mutual information (NMI)
metrics.reading: How much knowing a gene's cluster tells you about its label.

metrics.definition: 1 minus the uncertainty about the label left once the cluster is known, relative to the label's own entropy.
metrics.label: Homogeneity
metrics.reading: Whether each cluster holds one label.

metrics.definition: 1 minus the uncertainty about the cluster left once the label is known, relative to the clustering's entropy.
metrics.label: Completeness
metrics.reading: Whether each label sits in one cluster. Its harmonic mean with homogeneity is the V-measure, which equals NMI.

metrics.definition: Share of hidden genes HDBSCAN left as noise (in no cluster).
metrics.label: Unclustered share
metrics.reading: Context: noise genes cannot be recovered by any cluster.
